lessons.lesson: A cherry-pick over a rename leaves commits that do not compile, so every commit in a range must typecheck.
seen: A branch used model ids that a later commit renamed.
A second commit on that branch used the renamed model ids.

lessons.lesson: Count an image in the working context by its per-image token estimate, not by the length of its data URL.
seen: Photos of about 800 KB filled the context threshold and failed every turn.

enforcement.name: an image counts by its per-image estimate, not its encoded length

lessons.lesson: Size text pieces by their JSON-escaped length, the measure the context limit uses.
seen: Control-character text split by raw length exceeded the context threshold.

enforcement.name: text that JSON escapes heavily is still split into pieces below the threshold

lessons.lesson: Give every fetch in app code a timeout or an abort signal. The security check scans the app, not the server.
seen: The native probe's report fetch had no timeout.

lessons.lesson: Do not remount native views with a key to reset them. nitro-symbols 0.0.8 does not reset a recycled view, so it keeps another icon.
seen: key={chatId} on the chat list showed the wrong SF Symbols.

lessons.lesson: Every Responses model sets compactThreshold, the token count sent as compact_threshold. The working-context threshold is a different unit.
seen: The GPT models sent the 800,000 working-context threshold as compact_threshold.

enforcement.name: a Responses model without compactThreshold is not a model config

lessons.lesson: Bind a CI or result watcher to the commit you pushed, and confirm the head before you act on its result.
seen: A CI watcher checked an old head after the branch had moved.

lessons.lesson: Parse or narrow a value instead of asserting its type.
seen: 6 assertions in legacy demo files at the first measurement.

lessons.lesson: Stop exporting what nothing imports, or list the entry point with a reason.
seen: 45 unused exports at the first measurement.
